checks.text: The agent takes the expected action: draft, skip, or route to the owner.
No draft for an opted-out contact, a do-not-contact account, or a personal mailbox.
No cold draft to an existing customer, an open opportunity, or another rep's account; route it instead.
A routed account names its owner in the reason.
Usage stays in aggregate: no user names, no project names, no exact user, project or deploy counts.
No price, discount, credit, or trial offer (a rep handles all of that).
Every id in facts_used is a research fact or seller value prop that exists.
Steps 1 and 2 return a subject and body; step 3 returns only a call opener.
Step 1 body at most 110 words, step 2 at most 70, step 3 opener at most 45.
A first email's subject is 2 to 6 words and never fakes a reply; a follow-up stays in the first thread.
Addressed to the contact by first name and signed by the rep.
Every email ends with the opt-out line.
A follow-up email uses at least one fact the first email did not.
